title: AI-Native SDLC Playbook: Rewiring Your Engineering Pipeline
metaDescription: Discover how to transition from AI-assisted coding to an AI-native SDLC. Learn how embedded AI agents optimize planning, coding, and quality across your pipeline.
summary: This blog post explores the transition from episodic "AI-assisted" coding to an fully integrated "AI-native" software development lifecycle (SDLC). It outlines how embedding AI agents natively into planning, requirements gathering, and coding phases helps resolve the Productivity versus Quality Paradox. Ultimately, it provides a blueprint for turning developers into air traffic controllers for autonomous AI systems.
